hero.tagline: Sovereign Industrial Intelligence Platform for Dual-Use Manufacturing
hero.badge_1: Part of the DWS IQ Industrial Intelligence Suite
hero.intro: Aegis is a single-tenant sovereign AI platform engineered specifically for dual-use factories, heavy manufacturing, and critical raw material infrastructure. Deployed on dedicated Finnish infrastructure, Aegis continuously optimizes and secures the production facilities that supply Europe's defence sector — ensuring absolute data isolation with zero US cloud dependencies and designed to reduce CLOUD Act exposure.
hero.subtitle: Named after Athena's shield — Aegis provides protection through intelligence. Dedicated Kubernetes cluster per customer. No shared tenancy. No US cloud. Covering all 21 EU-regulated industries including dual-use critical raw materials.

edip.h2: EDIP-Ready: Built for the EU Defence Industrial Programme
edip.intro: The European Commission adopted its €1.5 billion EDIP work programme on 30 March 2026, allocating €700M+ for industrial production ramp-up, €240M for joint procurement, and €100M for defence SME equity. Aegis is explicitly architected to satisfy EDIP Article 9 eligibility requirements, providing ready-made compliance infrastructure for facilities receiving EDIP funding (subject to formal EU evaluation).

financial_engine.p1: The shift from experimental AI to regulated enterprise operations is not merely a technical challenge — it is a strategic pivot to monetize industrial certified assets. By decoupling AI innovation from safety-critical kernels, industrial enterprises move from a cycle of continuous re-certification costs to a repeatable, scalable asset model.
financial_engine.p2: Integrating DWS IQ turns compliance from a cost center into a driver of what we call "Financial Alpha" — the point where efficiency gains outpace compute costs. Governed, KYA-tiered swarm deployments are architected to reach that threshold faster than unmanaged, single-agent deployments. The same architecture lets industrial enterprises automate compliance, reduce re-certification cost and liability exposure compared with manual processes, and produce the defensible, auditable evidence trail that insurers and courts weigh under the Revised Product Liability Directive.

Aegis does not compete on the tactical frontline; it wins on the factory floor and across the supply chain — the dual-use industrial base that powers defence — on absolute EU sovereignty and deep compliance.

signal_trace.subtitle: Illustrative cross-vertical trace — pre-GA model demonstration
signal_trace.note: Deterministic reconstruction from public EU data sources, representative of the Aegis signal-tracing model ahead of August 2026 general availability.
signal_trace.scenario: Representative scenario: a kiln structural failure disrupts a major regional lime processing facility, and local media dismisses it as a routine, isolated maintenance event. The Aegis model intercepts the facility's anomaly signatures and traces the downstream dual-use industrial supply-chain cascade:

trace_stages.trigger: 1. Trigger | Critical raw materials | Localized facility shutdown flagged; regional supply-concentration risk for high-purity calcium oxide recalculated
trace_stages.upstream: 2. Upstream | Steel & alloys | Flux shortage detected → imminent CBAM tariff spike predicted for non-EU steel imports required by nearby shipyards
trace_stages.midstream: 3. Midstream | Cement & infrastructure | Calcination feedstock constraint → cascading clinker bottleneck impacting regional defence installations
trace_stages.downstream: 4. Downstream | Defence infrastructure | Raw-material substitution linked to net embodied-carbon increase → prime contractors warned of impending CSRD E1 disclosure breach
trace_stages.regulatory: 5. Regulatory | Cross-vertical | Structural failure cross-referenced against the CER Act — unmonitored mineral-processing vulnerability exposed

signal_trace.metric: five interconnected industrial sectors mapped, four European regulatory frameworks satisfied, one signal chain resolved via deterministic, zero-hallucination multi-agent tracing — fully audited back to verifiable public EU sources.

pricing.pricing_note: Tiers price hardware, SLA, support and sovereignty assurance — they do not gate the deployment mode. Local / edge operation is available in every tier, because the control-room use case requires it architecturally rather than as an upgrade. No hardware is bundled or resold in any mode. DWS supplies the software platform and the governance layer only. Cloud-mode GPU inference runs on L40S nodes inside the EU-hosted single-tenant cluster — nothing is shipped to site. Local and hybrid deployments run on customer- or partner-procured hardware, scoped per engagement. Edge devices are sold as their own SKUs, separately from Aegis onboarding.

deployment_architecture.intro: Aegis is engineered local-first for deep and reliable industrial operations. In manufacturing control rooms, dual-use facilities, and air-gapped plants, compliance execution cannot rely on external connectivity. Local operation is an architectural requirement for critical environments, while cloud hosting remains a valid deployment choice for broader enterprise workloads.
deployment_architecture.mode_local: Local / Edge: For manufacturing control rooms and other critical or dual-use sites. Core agent execution, evidence capture, identity verification, audit logs, and human kill authority stay strictly on-site, so core operational outcomes do not depend on network availability.
deployment_architecture.mode_cloud: EU-Sovereign Cloud: For non-critical enterprise workloads, development environments, cross-site reporting, and customers that accept network dependency.
deployment_architecture.mode_hybrid: Hybrid: Local execution (preserving bounded, dimensioned compute economics for deep workflows) with optional outbound synchronization, backup, or compliance reporting to an EU-sovereign cloud.
deployment_architecture.commercial_p1: Pricing tiers structure commercial coverage, hardware footprint, SLAs, and dedicated engineering support — they do not gate deployment modes. Local-first execution is required for control-room deployments, but Aegis does not claim that every enterprise deployment is offline by default.
deployment_architecture.commercial_p2: To validate local execution before committing to major hardware investments, the 3-month Aegis Pilot proves the complete local operational path directly on existing customer infrastructure or a compact edge appliance prior to DGX procurement.
deployment_architecture.commercial_p3: The pilot is a staged first payment, not an additional fee — it is credited in full against Aegis onboarding if you proceed within six months, so the total cost to production is unchanged.
deployment_architecture.supply_continuity: Supply continuity. The models we adopt ship as open weights, so the inference layer is portable by design rather than tied to one vendor's stack. A non-NVIDIA fallback path (AMD, Intel accelerators) is carried in our supply-risk plan, and hardware compatibility is validated per engagement rather than assumed. The full supply-risk register is available under NDA.
deployment_architecture.year1_cost: Year-1 cost context: Aegis Standard totals ≈ €72K in Year 1 (€59,990 + €999×12) — roughly 13× lower than a comparable Palantir Year-1 engagement (~€920K). The Defence and Sovereign tiers scale with GPU, support, and clearance requirements (Defence Year-1 ≈ €114K). Comparison applies to the Standard tier.
